title: Lung Disease Collection (Qatar): Evaluation of the Lungs of Individuals With Lung Disease
brief_summary: The purpose of this protocol is to obtain biologic samples from the blood and lungs from patients with lung diseases in order to study the causes and indications of these disorders, learn how these lung disease manifest and progress, and how the lung disease can be treated.
study_population: Recruitment will be from the patients of the Hamad Medical Corporation and others as relevant. The source of potential subjects will be the population of potential subjects with lung disease, as defined by the elegibility criteria, in Qatar. Accrual will be random with no bias as to gender or racial/ethnic group.
